paper.title: EvoAgentX: An Automated Framework for Evolving Agentic Workflows
paper.central_claim: EvoAgentX统一自动工作流构建、执行、评测与TextGrad/AFlow/MIPRO非权重优化，使agent prompts、配置和拓扑在多任务上改善。

provenance.notes: 任务与环境声明实际模型为 gpt-6.1-sol；无独立运行回执或可验证模型/session标识，按模板保留 null，未额外探测。

sections_read: 全文：摘要、引言、相关工作、方法、实验、结论/局限及材料内全部附录

evidence.quote: automate the generation, execution, evaluation, and evolutionary optimization of agentic workflows
evidence.support_explanation: 不仅静态MAS工具；含有对非权重workflow的反馈优化

evidence.quote: Each workflow is modeled as a directed graph:
evidence.support_explanation: 对象是task节点/依赖边，交给成熟优化器

evidence.quote: updates prompts and configurations based on evaluation feedback
evidence.support_explanation: 非权重编辑的反馈路径明确

evidence.quote: iteratively restructuring workflow graphs by reordering nodes, modifying dependencies, and exploring alternative execution strategies
evidence.support_explanation: 持久改变执行拓扑，不是仅内联反思

evidence.quote: The memory optimizer remains under active development.
evidence.support_explanation: 不能把概念中的memory优化当已实现成果

evidence.quote: File handling components manage workflow states and agent checkpoints
evidence.support_explanation: 框架留存与恢复设施；不等于已通过回退门控实验

evidence.quote: increasing the HotPotQA F1 score from 63.58% to 71.02%
improving the MATH solve rate from 66.00% to 76.00%
The enhanced prompt now incorporates intermediate steps, clear explanations of relevant mathematical concepts, and a thorough breakdown of the problem-solving approach.
evidence.support_explanation: 优化后prompt示例与few-shot资产展示；非权重更新

evidence.quote: The workflow now involves multiple agents for problem analysis, code generation, and solution refinement
evidence.support_explanation: 后续执行结构实际增加多个stage与ensemble，预算混杂需控制

evidence.quote: OWL achieves an overall accuracy improvement of 20.00%
evidence.support_explanation: GAIA作者报告增幅；百分比/百分点及样本分母没有清楚区分
夸张增幅必须有原始成功数才能判断，不能当绝对100%正确率

evidence.quote: The optimizer is initialized with the paths to the workflow, LLM configurations, and optimization parameters.
evidence.support_explanation: API实例演示优化/执行模型分离和保存路径，不等于主实验全部配置

evidence.quote: The task-specific evaluator computes domain-relevant metrics by comparing workflow outputs against ground truth labels
evidence.support_explanation: 标准任务真值评测，区分可选LLM评价
并非所有算法在每任务都改善：MBPP68低于原69

evidence.quote: most existing frameworks rely on fragmented toolchains or require manual setup
evidence.support_explanation: 主要贡献是工程统一/可用性，非首次发现workflow搜索
